title: Scope and deliver a professional services engagement
summary: When the company sells a defined consulting, implementation or other services project. An accepted engagement with controlled scope changes, delivery evidence and a reconciled commercial handover.
outcomes: An accepted engagement with controlled scope changes, delivery evidence and a reconciled commercial handover.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the company sells a defined consulting, implementation or other services project.

parts.title: Translate the requested outcome into deliverables
parts.guidance: Record the customer problem, deliverables, exclusions, dependencies and acceptance evidence. Identify who supplies access and decisions, and label estimates separately from commitments.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Approve scope capacity and contractual risk
parts.guidance: The delivery and commercial owners review staffing, milestones, payment terms, intellectual property and liability with relevant advisers. Resolve obligations the team cannot fulfill before proposing the engagement.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Approve scope capacity and contractual risk

parts.title: Execute the approved engagement agreement
parts.guidance: Authorized signatories approve and sign the reviewed statement of work and agreement. Retain the signed scope and approval record before scheduling externally committed work.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Deliver work and control changes
parts.guidance: Named delivery owners perform the engagement and review customer dependencies. Record requested changes with their cost, timing and acceptance impact; obtain approval before taking on additional obligations.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Reconcile delivery evidence and open exceptions
parts.guidance: Compile completed deliverables, time or milestone evidence and unresolved issues against the signed scope. Draft acceptance and invoicing records without claiming that silence proves customer acceptance.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Obtain acceptance and close the engagement
parts.guidance: The accountable delivery owner confirms acceptance or disputes through the agreed route. Hand remaining obligations, support and approved invoice evidence to their owners and record lessons for future estimates.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Obtain acceptance and close the engagement

verify.how: An accepted engagement with controlled scope changes, delivery evidence and a reconciled commercial handover.

notes.text: Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is UK public-sector practice; adapted operational coordination. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.
